_comment: Shared audit configuration template. Copy to <report-folder>/audit-config/global.json and fill in the personal fields (owner, watchlists, tool versions). Severity policy is DATA, not vibes: the guardrail reads it, it does not invent it. Never commit your filled-in copy to a repo you intend to publish.

toolVersions._comment: Pin the versions installed on your machine so a version bump is visible in the normalized diff, never silently absorbed. 'PENDING-INSTALL' = not yet installed; that sensor records a skip.
toolVersions.eslint: PENDING (per-repo; resolved from the repo's own node_modules when it has a JS/TS config)

severityPolicy._comment: Maps a finding category to a default severity. The guardrail may raise or lower within a category ONLY with cited evidence (e.g. an allowlisted fixture downgrades a secret hit to noise). Critical findings force BLOCK and are non-overridable except by a recorded human waiver.

tone._comment: Matching is CASE-INSENSITIVE with WORD BOUNDARIES (\b...\b) - mandatory. Substring-prone words like 'arse'/'crap'/'ass' otherwise match parse/scrap/class. The sensor over-reports on purpose; the guardrail separates quoted/legitimate use from real violations. properNounWatchlist = names you never want in a published repo (employers, colleagues, internal teams) - PERSONAL DATA, fill in locally and never publish your filled-in config.

contextSensitiveNouns._comment: Common words that are also names/vendors. Reported ONLY when a profanity or ventingPattern appears in the same line/sentence, so ordinary technical use doesn't flood the report.

hygiene._comment: codespellIgnoreWords: project coinages that would false-positive. Extend as new ones surface.

applyPerFileHeaders._comment: true = stamp the short Apache header into source files of this type; false = LICENSE + NOTICE pair is sufficient (markdown-heavy repos).
